gen-gf-badeen-display-fs-paquito: Paquito sits tight and friendly, its small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Badeen Display answers with knot-tied spacing and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, so this pairing works better for brief copy than for pages of text.
gen-gf-bahiana-fs-rowan: Solid blocks of words, cut like rod stock. Bahiana keeps every stroke at one measured thickness, which pays off when it is big and short, while Rowan's serif curves open generously beneath it.
gen-gf-bakbak-one-fs-paquito: Bakbak One curls its terminals like rolled tin and gives its oversized lowercase unshaded, constant strokes throughout. Paquito, a friendly serif, stays low in contrast.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-karma: Round, bubbly and loud about it. Baloo 2 lets its bowls fill the line for display work, while Karma's text serif keeps a gentle thick and thin variation made for reading.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-paquito: Paquito's classic serif has capitals and lowercase standing almost shoulder to shoulder, which gives its lines a confident, approachable look. Baloo 2 above it lets open counters breathe, and the body is best enjoyed in small doses.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-karma: Baloo Bhai 2 stretches wide-mouthed rounds up toward the top line, loud and low in contrast. And Karma, a serif with a subtle modulation and terminals that finish clear of the stem, brings the quiet, classic weight beneath it.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-paquito: Baloo Bhai 2 is the showoff, with wide-mouthed rounds that stretch high toward the top line. Paquito, a text serif with little gap between its small letters and capitals, is the one for settling into a handful of lines.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-karma: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 holds a tall central band of text, with open curves running through the whole alphabet. Karma, a classic serif, brings a mellow range of stroke weights that makes the two feel trustworthy and quietly different.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-karma: Karma is a serif that finishes its terminals well clear of the stem and keeps its capitals close to the lowercase. Under Baloo Bhaina 2, a heavy display face with wide-set s terminals, a longer stretch of it would read with a calm, trustworthy drift.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-paquito: Bold and loud, Baloo Bhaina 2 puts wide-set terminals on its s and a high x-height. Paquito, a text serif, keeps pace with a confident, friendly manner, though neither is meant for long paragraphs.
